source: Bian et al., arXiv:2610.31019v1 (HTML), re-read Nov 9 2026 11:55 +07
fixed_rule: greedy non-overlapping windows of at most 304 tokens (special tokens excluded) at token start offsets (Sec. IV, Setup)
recursive_rule: keep a span within its 400-token target, otherwise split in order at blank lines, line breaks, sentence terminators followed by whitespace (Sec. IV)
cdc_impl: Steadlith word-level Rabin (pinned implementation; Sec. II / IV)
metric: fraction of the new version's embedding-input workload recomputed under byte-identical reuse of complete embedding inputs (Sec. III)
pairs: 120 primary adjacent revision pairs (62 Chinese, 58 English); both versions 1,024-20,000 tokenizer units of body text (Sec. IV)
calibration: six calibration articles; document-balanced median chunk length within 15% across methods (Sec. IV)
input_format: plain text, each paragraph/heading/list item one whitespace-normalised block, blocks separated by a blank line (Sec. IV)
our_deviation: English simplewiki only; tokenizer = bge-small (theirs: their frozen encoder's tokenizer); pairs sampled from our filtered streams with the 1,024-20,000 token rule
